units.source_text: 常陆守一心想要隆重招待左近少将，

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was intent on entertaining the Sakon Minor Captain lavishly,

units.source_text: 但他不懂得如何可以办得体面阔绰，

en.t: but he did not know how to do it with proper elegance and grandeur,

units.source_text: 只管将东国土产的粗劣的绢一卷一卷地大量抛出，犒赏从人。

en.t: so he merely brought out great quantities of coarse silk from the eastern provinces, roll after roll, and rewarded the attendants with it.

units.source_text: 又搬出许多食物来，到处摆满，大声呼唤，叫大家来吃。

en.t: He also had a great deal of food carried out and set everywhere, calling loudly for everyone to come and eat.

units.source_text: 那些仆从都认为这招待真客气！

en.t: The servants all thought that this was truly generous hospitality.

units.source_text: 少将也很得意，认为攀这门亲真乃英明之见。

en.t: The Minor Captain was also quite pleased, thinking that making this marriage connection had been a very wise idea.

units.source_text: 夫人觉得在这兴头上离家而去，一切不管，似乎太乖戾了，

en.t: The lady felt that leaving home in the midst of all this excitement and abandoning everything would seem too unreasonable,

units.source_text: 因此暂时忍耐，一任常陆守作为，自己冷眼旁观。

en.t: so she endured it for the time being, let the Governor of Hitachi do as he pleased, and watched coldly from the side.

units.source_text: 常陆守奔忙策划：这里作为新婿的坐起间，那里作为随从人的住处。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi bustled about making arrangements: this place would be the new son-in-law's living quarters, and that place would house the attendants.

units.source_text: 他家屋子原很宽敞，然而东所被前妻所生女儿的夫婿源少纳言占住。

en.t: His house was originally quite spacious, but the eastern rooms were occupied by Gen Shonagon, the husband of the daughter born to his former wife.

units.source_text: 他家又有许多男子，因此没有空屋。

en.t: There were also many men in the household, and so there were no empty rooms.

units.source_text: 浮舟的房间已给新婿占住，就叫浮舟住在走廊末端的屋子里。

en.t: Ukifune's room had already been taken by the new son-in-law, so Ukifune was told to stay in a room at the end of the corridor.

units.source_text: 夫人颇感不满，觉得浮舟太委屈了，再三考虑的结果，才提出向二女公子请求借住。

en.t: The lady was quite dissatisfied and felt Ukifune was being treated too unfairly; after thinking it over again and again, she finally proposed asking the Second Princess for lodging.

units.source_text: 夫人想起：浮舟没有体面的后援人，以致被人欺负。

en.t: The lady reflected that because Ukifune had no respectable patron, she was being mistreated.

units.source_text: 因此不管二女公子不曾正式承认这妹妹，定要把她送来。

en.t: Therefore, regardless of the fact that the Second Princess had never formally acknowledged this younger sister, she was determined to send Ukifune to her.

units.source_text: 带来的只有乳母一人、青年侍女二三人，住在西厢北面人迹罕到的房间里。

en.t: She brought only one nurse and two or three young maids, and they stayed in a little-used room on the north side of the west wing.

units.source_text: 母夫人也陪同前来，特向二女公子问候。

en.t: The mother also came along and especially paid her respects to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 虽然多年以来音信隔绝，但毕竟不是陌生人。

en.t: Although they had been out of touch for many years, they were not strangers after all.

units.source_text: 二女公子和她们会面并不含羞。

en.t: The Second Princess showed no shyness when meeting them.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人觉得这二女公子真乃有福之贵人，看到她照料小公子的模样，又是羡慕，又是悲伤。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi's wife felt that the Second Princess was truly a blessed noblewoman, and seeing how she cared for the young prince, she felt both envy and sorrow.

units.source_text: 她想：“我是已故八亲王夫人的侄女，也是至亲至戚。

en.t: She thought, "I am the niece of the late wife of Prince Hachi, and I too am a very close relative.

units.source_text: 只因身为侍女，生下的女儿就不能参与姐妹之列，以致处境困苦，如此受人欺负。”

en.t: Only because I was a waiting woman, the daughter I bore cannot be counted among the sisters; because of that, she is in hardship and is treated so badly by others."

units.source_text: 这样一想，便觉今天强来亲近，亦甚乏味。

en.t: Thinking this, she felt that forcing this closeness today was also deeply dispiriting.

units.source_text: 此时二条院方向不利，无人前来访问，因此母夫人也在这里住了二三天。

en.t: At this time the direction of Nijo Palace was unlucky, and no one came to visit, so the mother also stayed here for two or three days.

units.source_text: 此次她方始可从容地看看这里的光景。

en.t: Only now was she finally able to look calmly at the scene here.
